payload.comment: Comparison stage is mechanically correct and internally consistent. Verified: (1) accuracy_delta = 0.922981 − 0.821309 = 0.101672 ✓; (2) baseline_met_or_exceeded = true is correct since 0.922981 > 0.821309; (3) common_seed (42) and common_split_fingerprint (9afc9ed3…c7505) match between the baseline_report and the agentic evaluation_report, confirming a fair same-split comparison; (4) the baseline is a fixed tiny_cnn control (hidden=16, depth=2, no class weighting, label_smoothing=0.0) with a stated rationale, appropriate as a conventional reference; (5) the agentic model (resnet18_wider_cw, hidden=48, class_weighting=true) outperforms the baseline by 10.17 pp accuracy and 14.81 pp macro-F1 (0.898925 vs 0.750857), a substantial and plausible margin given the architecture and hyperparameter differences. No deterministic findings. The warning-level observations carried from the evaluation and reporting anomaly reviews (val/test accuracy gap ~7.2 pp, Class 7 recall 0.620 / F1 0.737, Class 5 F1 0.767, label smoothing 0.1 slightly above the 0.0–0.05 CNN-head guideline, weight decay 0.001 below the 0.01 suggestion, best_epoch=15 at the budget boundary, 32.6% abstention rate) are properties of the trained model and its deployment profile, not defects in the comparison methodology. They are already flagged at their respective stages and do not invalidate the comparison result. The comparison report is complete for its declared primary_metric (accuracy) and schema_version 1.0. Proceeding.
llm_issues: Val/test accuracy gap (~7.2 pp) and the resulting 23× selective-risk gap at 80% coverage (val 0.0011 vs test 0.0258) are inherited from the evaluation stage; they do not affect the comparison arithmetic but should be monitored in any deployment decision.

Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall 0.620 / F1 0.737 and Class 5 (smooth muscle) F1 0.767 are the weakest per-class metrics; 113 combined misclassifications into debris/smooth-muscle. Not a comparison-stage defect but relevant context for the 10.17 pp accuracy gain.

Label smoothing 0.1 and weight decay 0.001 deviate slightly from architecture-research guidelines for CNN heads; no observed negative impact on either baseline or agentic metrics, noted for reproducibility.
